name: Energize
shortDescription: A UK web-based session-planning and resource service from Urban Saints for church children’s and youth leaders.
company: The Crusaders’ Union, operating as Urban Saints (company number 07771037; charity numbers 1144923 and SC039313)
suitableContexts: Churches that need adaptable session plans and leader resources

pricing.summary: Energize publishes subscriptions from £21 per month; its current pricing page lists a £25 per month or £300 per year rate for larger organisations. The supplier says prices can change, so confirm the applicable organisation band and payment terms before purchase.

startingPrice.qualifier: published ‘from’ price; supplier says prices are subject to change

tiers.label: Larger organisations
tiers.detail: For organisations with turnover above £300,000 in each of the last three published accounts.

gdprInformation: Energize’s privacy notice identifies Urban Saints as the website owner and data controller, and says the service is commercially operated by RaiseUpFaith. It lists third parties used for financial processing, call-centre operations, content and subscription management. Confirm the current data-processing terms, retention, hosting locations and roles for any church or child-related data before rollout.
coreFeatures: Web-based session resources for ages 3 to 15+
Bible-based games, activities, discussions and videos
View, edit and save session plans
Sharing and unlimited organisation users on subscriptions
Plan viewer for computer or tablet
Leader training articles and support resources
importExport: Supplier describes viewing, editing, saving and sharing session plans
Confirm downloading, printing, exporting and ownership arrangements for adapted materials before purchase
support: Urban Saints publishes a support contact route
Subscription includes access to supplier-described support and advice
Confirm support hours, response targets and safeguarding escalation process before purchase

uk-operator.value: The Energize privacy notice identifies Urban Saints as the operating name of The Crusaders’ Union, a company limited by guarantee registered in England and Wales, number 07771037.

church-workflow.value: Urban Saints describes Energize as web-based discipleship materials, with adaptable biblical sessions, training and support for leaders in churches and groups.

published-pricing.value: Energize publishes a subscription from £21 per month and a larger-organisation price of £25 per month or £300 per year, while noting that prices may change.

product-functions.value: Supplier pages describe session plans, a plan editor, session viewing on computer or tablet, resource access and a 30-day trial.

editorial.assessment: Energize is a web-based resource and planning service, rather than a child check-in, attendance or safeguarding case-management system. It is relevant where a UK church needs digitally managed children’s and youth session resources, but it should be evaluated separately from systems that store child records or coordinate safe collection.
bestFor: Churches seeking adaptable children’s and youth meeting plans
Teams that want shared leader access and a digital session editor
Volunteer leaders needing resources and training support
strengths: Specific church children’s and youth workflow
Session editor and shared-user capability are documented
Clear distinction from child-record management systems
limitations: It is a resource and session-planning service, not a child check-in or safeguarding case-management platform
Published prices are subject to supplier change
The public notice does not establish all procurement details for adapted content or user-data handling
Supplier says RaiseUpFaith commercially operates the service, so obtain current contracting and controller/processor roles in writing

procurementVerdict.problem: Preparing consistent, adaptable children’s and youth sessions for leaders
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK charity-owned web service combining session resources, an editor and leader support
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run the 30-day trial with representative leaders and confirm current pricing, permissions, adapted-content ownership and data-processing terms before purchase
